decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reasons for Approval: The proposed extension whilst exceeding the Council's stipulated projections in the House Extension Guidelines, would not have an adverse effect on the neighbouring property because of the presence of the existing boundary wall which is shown to be retained in the scheme. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1., and H.6.4 of the Council's Unitary Dvelopment Pla. The design is in keeping with that of the property, and not visible from the street and would comply with policy ENV-B.2.2 of the U.D.P.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - The roof glazing facing No. 12 shall be of obscured glass only and such materials shall be permanently retained.
Condition : 5 - The boundary wall adjoining No. 12 shall be permanently retained as shown on plan 738/1E.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.

Condition : 8 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Erection of single storey rear infill to dwellinghouse.(Grove Park Conservation Area)
